title: Reset settings
rowDescription: Restore language, appearance, theme and general preferences from your saved point or defaults. Resources and GPU configuration are preserved.
description: Only language, general preferences, appearance and theme change. Models, chats, assistants, skills, plugins, MCP, credentials, GPU configuration and code are preserved.
restoreSavedIntro: Reset restores the saved point. Your current configuration is saved separately so you can undo the reset.
restoreDefaultsIntro: Without a saved point, reset restores the defaults for these preferences, with Spanish as the language. Your current configuration is saved first so you can undo it.
noPoint: No saved point; the defaults with Spanish as the language will be used.
saveHint: Save a point to return to your current configuration later.
overwrite: Saving another point replaces the previous one with your current configuration.
defaultsHint: You can also ignore the saved point and use the defaults in Spanish. Your current configuration is saved so the change can be undone.
restoredSaved: Settings restored from the saved point. Your resources are preserved.
restoredDefaults: Settings restored to defaults in Spanish. Your resources are preserved.
undone: The configuration from before the reset was restored.
failed: The operation could not be completed.
readWarning: A saved point could not be read. You can save a new one or use defaults; no resources will be deleted.
